Filter-Eater Haze.name: Filter-Eater Haze
Filter-Eater Haze.description: The user pushes out a gas fine enough to slip through mask filters, visor seals and the joints of armor, and breathes it straight at a single target. It deals heavy toxic damage that ignores masks, respirators and worn armor; held back, it deals no damage and leaves the target too dizzy to stand until the end of their next turn. Strain: heavy.
